name: Simulation
criterion: Testbench passes on every regression vector; CPU golden and RTL agree bit for bit.

name: Package
criterion: Kernel packaged as .xo (or exported .xsa) with a clean interface report.

name: Hardware emulation
criterion: hw_emu run of the full host driver completes with identical outputs.

name: Hardware build
criterion: Timing closed at target clock, zero unwaived CDC criticals, bitstream programs.

name: Silicon validated
criterion: Hardware regression bit-exact against the golden model; power within the board cap.
